FX off (Bind Pose): edits change the base shape
Liquify: select a layer and drag (the edit permanently changes the layer\'s pixels)

Liquify: select one layer (image or PSD layer)
Brush: draw on an image layer (or create a “New layer”)
Eraser: erases pixels of an image layer
There is no eraser on a vector layer: “Remove last” deletes a primitive
You can draw on an image layer: select one or create a “New layer”

Vector layer “{}”: draw with the brush (path, line, rectangle, ellipse) or add “Shapes”
Animation layer “{}”: draw, “Add empty frame” creates the next drawing
Background “{}” is filled with the project color and locked (unlock it in the layer list)
Background “{}” is filled with the project color and locked (unlock it in the layer list). In a PSD project it sits above the PSD layers
Empty group “Group {}”: drag layers into it with the ≡ handle
Shape “{}” added to the vector layer
Loop on: playback restarts after the end
Loop off: playback stops on the last frame
Magnet on: the playhead snaps to keys, markers and clip edges

Mesh created from the outline: tap again to add a pin
Pin {}: drag it, the drawing follows the point
Select a pin (tap a green dot)
Pins returned to their original position
Turn on FX (the sparkle button): pin keys are written in animation mode

Eyedropper: tap the canvas to pick a color for the effect
Mesh bound to bones ({}): vertices move by weights
Mesh: select a layer, then “Generate” or “+Mesh” (tap adds a vertex)
The last triangle cannot be deleted: use “Delete” mesh
The layer is not loaded yet
Bone mode: “＋ Bone” and a finger drag draw a bone
Bones are created in Bind Pose mode
Bind Pose: the skeleton is set up, the image is not deformed
Animation: a bone moves its bound layers
Lasso: no layers inside the outline

Binding works in Bind Pose mode
Auto bind works in Bind Pose mode
No free layers intersect the bones
Not allowed: the parent is itself bound to this layer
Select two or more layers (the multi-select button)
Stagger: {} clips back to back, each end = next start
Stagger: {} clips back to back; {} did not fit and hit the end of the project (increase the duration)
Not allowed: a group cannot go into itself
Images, video and text cannot be put into PSD groups yet
Layer moved out of the group
The symbol has no markers. Double-tap the symbol to open it: the “Markers” button names a frame.
Keys: {}. A time key is always Hold: the symbol instantly jumps to the marker frame and holds it until the next key.
No effects. Tap “+ Add effect”: Chroma key, Blur, Color correction, Pixelate, Glow, Shadow and more. The chain applies top to bottom.
“{}” will appear in one of the next stages
The layer follows the parent\'s move, rotation and scale (eyes move with the head).
Drag clip edges on the timeline; drag the middle to move the selected clip.
Speed and reverse already work for audio; for video they will work together with video playback.
Applied by the effects shader (like “Color correction” before the others). Saved in the project.
The layer text is replaced by a number; “#” marks where the number goes (for example “$#”).
Create a project first (“+” at the top), then tap “Walk through in the editor”
“{}” and all its files will be deleted permanently.
Liquify: drag over the image · brush {}
Perspective · FX on: corners go to keys
FX on: the pin goes to keys
FX off: drag the pin (binding shape)
FX on: vertices go to keys
Warp · FX on: points go to keys

Layers as frames: each layer becomes a separate frame of the symbol and a marker with the layer\'s name appears on that frame - handy for mouth shapes and drawing-based animation.\n\nLayers stacked: all layers stay together and visible at once (one compound object).
No layers yet. Tap “+” at the top to add a PSD, image, video or text.
Double-tap the line for a new node, long-press a node to delete it. Drag a node and the red (In) / blue (Out) handles: that is how S-curves, springs and falloff are made. Time → right, value ↑ up.
Red is the previous drawing, green is the next. Works on an image layer with frames (the “Add empty frame” button).
A ready project with hints on the buttons
This is a ready project: three shapes on the canvas, each on its own layer. Hints will point out the main buttons one by one. “Skip” closes the lesson at any time.
Turn on “Brush” to draw on an image layer. The “New layer” button above the canvas creates a clean layer for a drawing.
The layer list is on the right: the eye hides a layer, the ≡ handle changes order, the lock locks. Press and hold a layer row to open its menu.
The red line is the current frame. Drag it along the ruler: near the screen edge the timeline scrolls by itself. “Play” starts playback.
Select a shape, move the playhead, move the shape and tap “Add Key”. Motion between keys is computed automatically. “Stagger” lines up the selected clips back to back.
Done? Tap “Export”, choose MP4, GIF or an image and share the result.
You can repeat the lesson from the “Tutorials” section at any time.
On the projects screen tap “＋” at the top, choose an aspect ratio and “Create”.
top right of the projects screen
Add an image, video or audio
In the editor open the actions menu and choose a file type. An image is placed in the center of the canvas.
Tap an object to select it. One finger moves it, two fingers rotate and scale.
With nothing selected, two fingers pan and zoom the view. To restore it: “Reset canvas view” in the actions menu.
Tapping an empty area clears the selection.
The project saves itself a couple of seconds after an edit.
How to add and animate text
Tap the “Text” tool on the left, type the caption and confirm.
Select the text and open “Properties”: font, size, color, gradient.
Go to the frame you want and tap “Add Key” on the timeline.
Move it and set a second key
Go to another frame, move the text and tap “Add Key” again. The text will move between the keys.
The f(x) curve button next to a key changes the smoothness of motion.
Text can be bent: add Warp to it.
How Bones and Bind Pose work
Choose “Bones” in the top bar. The skeleton tools appear on the left.
Choose “+Bone” and drag on the canvas to set length and direction. The next bone started at the end of the selected one becomes its child.
Set up the skeleton in Bind Pose
Turn on Bind Pose to move bones without distorting the image and fit the skeleton to the character.
toggle at the top left of the canvas
“Auto bind” binds layers by itself. For manual binding: “Lasso” the arm layers, select a bone and tap “Bind”.
Switch the toggle to Animation, choose the “Bones” tool and drag the end of a bone.
“Independent rotation” in bone properties keeps its angle while the parent rotates.
Draw bones in order: shoulder → forearm → hand.
Two ways to bend an image
Tap a layer on the canvas or in the layer list. Warp works with images, text and PSD layers.
Scroll down the left panel and choose “Warp”. A grid of 16 points appears on the layer.
Drag any point: the image bends smoothly. This is how squash and stretch are made.
“Reset” in the floating panel removes the deformation.
FX off: an edit changes the base shape. FX on: an edit is written as a key on the current frame.
Switch to “Mesh” mode, select a layer and tap “Generate” (or “By outline”). Drag vertices, cut with the “Cut” tool, nudge softly with “Smudge”.
Create bones, then tap “Bones” in the mesh panel: vertices will move by bone weights instead of the whole layer.
“Perspective” tilts a layer by 4 corners. “Effects → Turbulent Displace” adds waviness and Line Boil. “Liquify” pushes the image\'s pixels with a finger.
Set the shape with FX off first, then animate.
Move a layer into a group
Press and hold a layer row and drag it onto a group: the layer becomes its child. Drag it onto a root layer: it leaves the group.
A left swipe opens the layer menu, a right swipe turns on multi-select.
Images and text cannot be put into PSD groups.
The mouth speaks to the audio
Turn on “Brush” and tap “New layer” in the drawing bar: each mouth shape (A, O, M, Rest...) is drawn on its own layer.
Select the layers and create a symbol

Enter multi-select, mark the layers, press and hold a layer row and choose “Create symbol”. In the dialog choose “Layers as frames”: each layer becomes a frame of the symbol with a marker named after the layer.
“Layers stacked” keeps everything visible at once - for a compound character, not for lip-sync.

Double-tap a symbol (or “Edit symbol” in the layer menu) to open it. The “Markers” button at the top names the current frame (Rest, AI, E, O, U, MBF, L, W or your own). “◀ Back to main scene” returns.
the “◀ Back to main scene” bar above the canvas

“＋” → Audio. The project extends to the end of the sound by itself. The waveform shows on the audio bar; dragging the playhead along the ruler plays a short snippet - that is how you find each phoneme by ear.
Pick a marker on a frame

Select the symbol on the main scene: in “Properties → Time” tap “Pick marker”. A floating panel with pictures opens: move it where convenient, hide it to the edge or close it with the cross. Stop the playhead on a sound and tap the right mouth.
The active marker has a purple frame.

Each tap on a marker sets a Hold time key: the mouth does not scrub, it instantly becomes the chosen one and stays until the next key. Keys show as purple ticks on the symbol bar. The “key” icon sets a key with the current value manually.
Keys can be deleted (the “Remove key” button on the current frame) or all cleared: the symbol loops again.
Turn on selection, box the keys, drag: they move together.
Select several layers and tap “Stagger”: the clips line up back to back: the end of one is the start of the next.
Select several layers and tap “Stagger”: the clips line up back to back.
Drag the gray handle above the timeline up or down. Eject collapses the timeline.
A two-finger pinch on the timeline changes the time scale.
Walk through in the editor: buttons are highlighted
Fill: tap a closed area (threshold, expand and gap are in the bar above the canvas)
Selection: outline an area or tap with the wand; drag inside the selection to move it
Smudge: drag across the drawing of an image layer
Pen: tap to place points on a vector layer, “Done” finishes the outline, tapping the first point closes it
The tool works on an image layer: select one or create a “New layer”
The layer is getting ready, try again
Nothing to fill here: the area is already this color or the tap hit a line
The pen draws on a vector layer: “＋” → “Vector”, then choose “Path” again
An outline needs at least two points
No folders yet: create one with the button at the top.
Layered PSD of the current frame: layers and groups are kept, blend modes too. Text, video, symbols and vector go as raster; layer opacity is baked into pixels.
All project tracks are mixed into one WAV (stereo 44.1 kHz) for the whole project duration.
A backup of the project with all its files. It can be imported on the projects screen.
Each frame is a PNG with a transparent background, all in one ZIP. This replaces MOV video with alpha: Android cannot do ProRes 4444.
Allowed from 64 to 4096 px. This cannot be undone with Undo.
Resize scales layers with the canvas, Crop keeps the chosen frame. These actions cannot be undone with Undo.
The file does not look like a VibeToon backup (.tsproj)
Selection moved to layer “{}”: you can now bind it to a bone
“To new layer” works on an image layer (not a PSD layer)
Keys: {}. Volume changes linearly between keys; it holds before the first and after the last. Works in playback, ruler scrubbing and WAV. MP4 has no audio yet.
Press the new key on the keyboard
A physical keyboard is required. Undo and redo work with Ctrl.
PSD Import Mode: layers as in the file
Layer has no animation: edits apply to all frames. To animate, add a key with the ◎ button on the timeline
Press Back again to return to the projects list
No symbols yet: select layers and create a symbol
Importing images as symbols is enabled in Settings → Import.
Items marked “Coming soon” do nothing yet; the rest are saved and apply immediately.
Compatible video export (if the video has stripes)
Symbol “{}” has not redrawn yet: showing the previous frame, retrying
GPU memory is almost full ({} of {} MB): some layers are shown at reduced size
